name: FV_TREASURY_CONFIRM_ALL
description: This table contains payments confirmed in the treasury confirmation.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the business unit associated to the treasury confirmation.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Number of payments made for the payment instruction.

columns.name: REVISION_NUM
columns.description: Revision number for the treasury confirmation record.

columns.name: TREASURY_CONFIRMATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the treasury confirmation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ACCOUNTED_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the accounting status of the payments. Valid values can be Accounted, Unaccounted, and Partially Accounted.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Payment Instruction.

columns.name: TREASURY_CONFIRM_DATE
columns.description: The date that Treasury confirmed the payment schedule.

columns.name: TREASURY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment process request amount.

columns.name: RANGE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the range applies to a single paymnet or a range of payments. The value will be one of the look up codes from lookup type  ORA_FV_PAYMENT_RANGE_TYPE and valid values are Single, Multiple.

columns.name: FROM_CHECK_NUM
columns.description: The from range number for the single range type.

columns.name: TO_CHECK_NUM
columns.description: The to range number for the single range type.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of treasury confirmation. Valid values include Confirmed, Unconfirmed, and Backed Out.

columns.name: CONFIRMED_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the latest subledger accounting confirmation event.

columns.name: BACKOUT_EVENT_ID
columns.description: This column is not currently used for Treasury Confirmation.

columns.name: CONFIRMED_ACCOUNTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the latest treasury confirmed accounting is complete.

columns.name: BACKOUT_ACCOUNTED_FLAG
columns.description: This column is not currently used for Treasury Confirmation.

columns.name: CONTROL_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique Id assigned by the Treasury.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_DATE
columns.description: Date and time of the summary schedule submission.

columns.name: FEDERAL_PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies file type of the payment, PAM or SLS.

columns.name: PAYMENT_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Groups a category of suppliers or invoices for single pay run.

columns.name: PAYMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method of payment, such as check, electronic, or wire.

columns.name: AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE
columns.description: Identifier for the accounting office within an agency that reports disbursements and collections to Treasury.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PROCESS_REQUEST_NAME
columns.description: Name of payment process request submitted.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date of the creation of the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Payment date of payments generated for given check run.
